title: Pickety Configuration
description: Configuration for Pickety, a high-performance architectural enforcement engine for TypeScript.

modules.description: Map module names to file glob patterns. Files belong to the first module that matches.
modules.markdownDescription:
Map module names to file glob patterns. Files belong to the first module that matches.

Example:
```json
{
  "features": "src/features/*",
  "components": "src/components/**/*"
}
```

additionalProperties.description: Glob pattern for the module files.

importer.description: Source module name or glob pattern.
importer.markdownDescription:
Source module name or glob pattern.

Supports `$variable` interpolation to match importer subdirectories with target subdirectories.

imports.description: Target module name, glob, or relative path pattern.
imports.markdownDescription:
Target module name, glob, or relative path pattern.

Supports `$variable` interpolation.

allow.description: Permit or deny the import. Defaults to false (deny).

message.description: Custom error message shown in the editor.

severity.description: Override the global severity for this specific rule.

name.description: Unique identifier for the rule. Used in diagnostics and 'Go to Rule' navigation.

boundary-diagrams.description: Generate a Mermaid diagram on save.
boundary-diagrams.markdownDescription:
Automatically generate a Mermaid diagram of module boundaries on every save.

- `true`: Writes to `picket-boundaries.mermaid` in workspace root.
- `"path/to/file.mermaid"`: Writes to a custom path.
